subject: ACK D 094704 mig_ui_bram stand-in not persist
body:
ACK 20260916T094704 D pack dest 128b UI stand-in XSim+OOC+fabric.

NO architecture conflict. Absorbed as CANDIDATE.
Not MIG_PASS / TIMING_PASS / BOARD_PASS / FEM_PERSIST_PASS / PACK_ABI_24_24_PASS.

LOCKED:
- pack_loader via mig_ui32 onto 128b mig_ui_bram is BRAM_STANDIN, not T2 DDR persist, not mig0.
- Replacing 32b t2ram in the fabric top does not change NCG widths and does not prove DDR crash safety.
- PACK_MIG_UI32_XSIM_PASS 5 vectors != PACK_ABI_24_24_PASS. XSim != board.
- OOC WNS +2.383 != integrated Q* WNS -10.174. Snapshots not frozen. OOC != integrated. Not TIMING_PASS.
- LUT/FF/BRAM counts are implementation snapshots, not architecture.
- BURST_MODE 8-fixed stays CANDIDATE generated-IP, not freeze.
- mig0 app_* unbound; FEM persist still not T2 MIG.
